**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 (¶¶ p0082–p0084) is the document's only audit right binding us, and it already sits at the playbook's **preferred** position:

| Term | Playbook preferred | Section 22 |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | ≤ once / 12 months | once in any twelve-month period ✓ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | thirty days' prior written ✓ |
| Timing/manner | business hours | normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption ✓ |
| Auditor | independent, confidentiality-bound | same, off-site where practicable ✓ |
| Cost | Vendor unless underpayment > 5% | Vendor unless > five percent ✓ |
| System access | none | express bar on direct system access, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material ✓ |

Section 22.3 adds further customer-side protection (findings are Customer Confidential Information, enforcement-only use, copy of final report, payment resolves the issue). Section 23 ("Records and Customer Assurance") carries no operative text, and a document-wide search found no other inspection, verification, or monitoring right running against us.
